rationale: The Old English lemma "Galleas" (plural of "Gallea") refers to the Gauls/French people, a gentile/ethnonym. The Bede attestation (Bd. 5, 11) uses it in a geographic/ethnic context referring to inhabitants of Gaul/France, making the collective people sense (french.n.02) more appropriate than the language sense. The personal name sense (french.n.03) is clearly inapplicable.
